typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		CLIENT as string,
		PRODUCT as string,
		ACCOUNT_NUMBER as string,
		TYPE as string,
		Chk as string,
		ACCOUNT_NAME as string,
		CUSIP as string,
		Symbol as string,
		Quantity as string,
		ORIGINAL_PRICE as string,
		NET_AMOUNT as string,
		DTC as string,
		CUSTOMER_NUMBER as string,
		MARKET_STATUS as string,
		CageKey as string,
		BuySell as string,
		TRADE_DATE as string,
		SETTLEMENT_DATE as string,
		AFFIRMATION_DATE1 as string,
		AFFIRMED1 as string,
		IDControl as string,
		Blotter as string,
		INV as string,
		BRRepID1 as string,
		SALES_PERSON as string,
		SALES_ASSISTANT as string,
		SALES_MANAGER as string,
		BACK_UP1 as string,
		SALES_GROUP as string,
		ADP_NUMBER as string,
		Description as string,
		TRADE_NUMBER as string,
		IsCancel as string,
		OFFSET as string,
		Currency as string,
		Origin as string,
		CPNRATE as string,
		LegalID as string,
		LegalName as string,
		COMMENTS as string,
		CommentDate1 as string,
		Commenter1 as string,
		Reason as string,
		BRRR as string,
		DO_CLH_NBR as string,
		CLIENT_CLNAME_PROD as string,
		CounterParty as string,
		POSITION_GROUP_DESCRIPTION as string,
		SPIN as string,
		AGENTINTACCOUNTNUMBER1 as string,
		DTCAGENTBANKNUMBER as string,
		DTCINSTID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource	source(output(
		Trade_Date as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
FlatFileSource derive(loadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		Affirmation_Date_Drv = iif(isNull(AFFIRMATION_DATE1) || (AFFIRMATION_DATE1 == ''), toDate(toString(null(), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy"), toDate(AFFIRMATION_DATE1, "MM/dd/yyyy")),
		CommentDate_Drv = iif(isNull(CommentDate1) || (CommentDate1 == ''), toDate(toString(null(), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy"), toDate(CommentDate1, "MM/dd/yyyy")),
		CPNRATE_Drv = iif(isNull(CPNRATE) || (CPNRATE == ''), toFloat(null()), toFloat(CPNRATE)),
		ORIGINAL_PRICE_Drv = iif(isNull(ORIGINAL_PRICE) || (ORIGINAL_PRICE == ''), toFloat(null()), toFloat(ORIGINAL_PRICE)),
		TRADE_DATE_Drv = iif(isNull(TRADE_DATE) || (TRADE_DATE == ''), toDate(toString(null(), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy"), toDate(TRADE_DATE, "MM/dd/yyyy")),
		SETTLEMENT_DATE_Drv = iif(isNull(SETTLEMENT_DATE) || (SETTLEMENT_DATE == ''), toDate(toString(null(), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy"), toDate(SETTLEMENT_DATE, "MM/dd/yyyy"))) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn,LookupLKPTABLE lookup(FlatFileSource@TRADE_DATE == LookupLKPTABLE@Trade_Date,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup filter(!isMatch()) ~> Lookup0
Lookup0 sink(input(
		Origin as string,
		IDControl as string,
		DTCINSTID as string,
		SETTLEMENT_DATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Chk as string,
		BuySell as string,
		Blotter as string,
		BRRR as string,
		ACCOUNT_NAME as string,
		PRODUCT as string,
		Currency as string,
		ACCOUNT_NUMBER as string,
		TYPE as string,
		SALES_MANAGER as string,
		LegalName as string,
		CUSTOMER_NUMBER as string,
		NET_AMOUNT as string,
		CLIENT_CLNAME_PROD as string,
		AGENTINTACCOUNTNUMBER as string,
		DTC as string,
		ADP_NUMBER as string,
		TRADE_DATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MARKET_STATUS as string,
		DTCAGENTBANKNUMBER as string,
		CageKey as string,
		ORIGINAL_PRICE as double,
		Description as string,
		Symbol as string,
		COMMENTS as string,
		Reason as string,
		loadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CommentDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		TRADE_NUMBER as string,
		CUSIP as string,
		INV as string,
		SALES_GROUP as string,
		CPNRATE as double,
		SALES_ASSISTANT as string,
		SALES_PERSON as string,
		OFFSET as string,
		SPIN as string,
		IsCancel as string,
		Quantity as string,
		BACK_UP as string,
		POSITION_GROUP_DESCRIPTION as string,
		CLIENT as string,
		DO_CLH_NBR as string,
		AFFIRMATION_DATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CounterParty as string,
		BRRepID as string,
		LegalID as string,
		Commenter as string,
		AFFIRMED as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Origin,
		IDControl,
		DTCINSTID,
		SETTLEMENT_DATE = SETTLEMENT_DATE_Drv,
		Chk,
		BuySell,
		Blotter,
		BRRR,
		ACCOUNT_NAME,
		PRODUCT,
		Currency,
		ACCOUNT_NUMBER,
		TYPE,
		SALES_MANAGER,
		LegalName,
		CUSTOMER_NUMBER,
		NET_AMOUNT,
		CLIENT_CLNAME_PROD,
		AGENTINTACCOUNTNUMBER = AGENTINTACCOUNTNUMBER1,
		DTC,
		ADP_NUMBER,
		TRADE_DATE = TRADE_DATE_Drv,
		MARKET_STATUS,
		DTCAGENTBANKNUMBER,
		CageKey,
		ORIGINAL_PRICE = ORIGINAL_PRICE_Drv,
		Description,
		Symbol,
		COMMENTS,
		Reason,
		loadDate,
		CommentDate = CommentDate_Drv,
		TRADE_NUMBER,
		CUSIP,
		INV,
		SALES_GROUP,
		CPNRATE = CPNRATE_Drv,
		SALES_ASSISTANT,
		SALES_PERSON,
		OFFSET,
		SPIN,
		IsCancel,
		Quantity,
		BACK_UP = BACK_UP1,
		POSITION_GROUP_DESCRIPTION,
		CLIENT,
		DO_CLH_NBR,
		AFFIRMATION_DATE = Affirmation_Date_Drv,
		CounterParty,
		BRRepID = BRRepID1,
		LegalID,
		Commenter = Commenter1,
		AFFIRMED = AFFIRMED1),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
